svg.text: Figure 1.1: Value Proposition Canvas — SmartStudy Assistant (Persona A & B)
Value Map (SmartStudy PoC Architecture)
1. Products & Services
• 12-question curated multi-disciplinary bank (Law, CS, Econ, SE)
• 36 option-level misconception traps (O(1) deterministic lookup)
• 5-dimension competency radar & progressive Trap Drawer UI
2. Pain Relievers
• Eliminates binary ✔/✘ blindness via per-distractor attribution
• Prevents LLM answer spoiling via Socratic follow-up prompts
• Zero hallucinated statutes/formulas (100% pre-verified corpus)
• Zero cloud/network dependency (< 2.5 ms local lookup, £0 cost)
3. Gain Creators
• Pinpoints exact prerequisite theorem/article within 5 seconds
• Visualises longitudinal cognitive strengths across 5 dimensions
• Instant bilingual (ZH/EN) & dual-theme revision environment
FIT
Customer Profile (University Exam Candidates)
1. Customer Jobs (Persona A & B)
• Pass high-stakes university exams under 2–3 week deadlines
• Distinguish adjacent statutory rules & boundary conditions
• Track which underlying competency dimension remains fragile
2. Customer Pains
• Binary feedback Trap: knowing an answer is wrong, not why
• General LLMs spoil the final answer immediately or hallucinate
• Repeating the exact same conceptual mistake ≥ 3 times
• Paywalls & unstable campus Wi-Fi blocking cloud AI tutors
3. Expected Gains
• Target revision towards missing prerequisites, not rote re-reading
• Zero-cost, zero-setup, offline-capable study tool
• Clear self-assessment of readiness before sitting exams
